text:
Alicia (eng-ops): Quick follow-up from the DB outage postmortem — we need a small, repeatable external summary template and a clear publishing schedule for incident summaries/RCA sharing. Who wants to own?
Matt (support): I can drive the customer-facing cadence. want to avoid long delays.
Jordan (prod): Agreed. We should make a short public summary + ETA for full RCA.
Samir (infra): Suggestion: initial status update within 1 hour of detection, preliminary summary within 24h, full public RCA within 3 business days unless legal needs more review.
Alicia (eng-ops): That sounds reasonable. Need an owner for each step and a checklist so no one misses comms.
Matt (support): I'll own the initial + 24h summaries. Can pair with someone from Eng for the RCA sign-off.
Priya (eng): I can be the engineering reviewer for RCA content (technical accuracy).
Tomas (sre): I'll take the internal remediation tracking and timeline enforcement.
Alicia (eng-ops): Great. Can we draft a short statuspage template now so I can push a PR to the statuspage copy? Paste example below.
Jordan (prod): Please yes — keep it short and neutral, no blame, include impact, mitigation, next steps, and CTA for customers.
Matt (support): Here's an MVP template — feel free to copy/edit:
```
Summary: We experienced a partial outage of inference routing affecting hosted requests to models X/Y.
Impact: Intermittent 5-15s timeouts for ~12% of requests between 2026-03-20 10:15 UTC and 2026-03-20 11:05 UTC.
Mitigation: Traffic automatically failed over to replica pool; engineering applied configuration fix at 11:00 UTC.
Next steps: Full RCA and remediation plan will be posted by 2026-03-23.
Contact: support@redwood.ai for questions.
```
Samir (infra): Two small edits: remove exact % if uncertain, and use 'some customers experienced increased error rates' — avoids weird rounding. Also mention affected regions if known.
Matt (support): Updated: will tweak wording and remove % before publish.
Legal (comms): Quick legal check — keep non-accusatory language, confirm that the mitigation description doesn't imply product admission of deeper faults. We'll do a quick review within 24h.
Alicia (eng-ops): Noted. Priya + Tomas: For RCA sharing policy — do we publish full technical RCA publicly or a sanitized customer-facing RCA and keep a deeper internal RCA?
Priya (eng): Recommend two docs: public RCA (high level + timelines + customer impact) within 3 business days, internal RCA (detailed logs, mitigations, code diffs) for internal teams and enterprise customers under NDA.
Tomas (sre): Agree. And we should track remediation owners & timelines as action items in the postmortem tracker — assign owner, due date, status (todo/in-progress/done). I'll add a recurring review cadence until all are done.
Matt (support): For customers who request the full internal RCA, we route via CSM + legal review. Add that to the process doc.
Alicia (eng-ops): OK owners recap: Matt = external comms (initial + 24h), Priya = engineering sign-off for public RCA, Tomas = remediation tracker owner, Samir = infra exec on mitigation details, Alicia = publish PR to statuspage copy + final signoff. Legal to review as needed. Does everyone agree?
All: :thumbsup:
Alicia (eng-ops): I'll create a short process doc and a template repo entry. Link once created. Target: have templates + owner assignments in docs by EOD tomorrow (2026-03-21).
ops-bot: Reminder set for 2026-03-21 17:00 UTC to check templates and ownership.
Matt (support): Also propose we add 'recurring incident pattern' check: if similar incident occurs twice in 90 days, escalate to postmortem re-open and exec review.
Jordan (prod): That escalation threshold seems useful. Add to process doc.
Priya (eng): I'll add the technical checklist for RCA completeness: timeline, root cause hypothesis, evidence (logs/graphs), mitigation steps, follow-up tasks, regression tests.
Tomas (sre): I'll create the remediation tracker sheet and give edit rights to owners.
Alicia (eng-ops): Thanks team. Once the doc + templates are in place, we should run a quick 30-min drill (mock incident) to ensure handoffs work.
Samir (infra): Happy to run the drill next week.
Alicia (eng-ops): Closing note: remember customer-facing comms should be short, factual, and include an ETA for the RCA. We'll get this into our incident SOPs.
Matt (support): I'll put a short blurb in the customer statuspage that links to the upcoming RCA page once published.
Legal (comms): I'll stand by for reviews.
Alicia (eng-ops): Thanks everyone — will post doc link here when ready.
